description: Alias of refine_shot. Fix a generated shot that came out wrong. Pass the prompt you used, the model, the mode and what went wrong in plain words ("feet sliding", "face drifted", "line cut off", "too glossy", "label morphing"), plus optional frame notes. Returns a diagnosis, specific prompt changes (from Atlas craft fixes and a per-model failure-mode library, credited), a revised prompt, and an escalation ladder: same-model fixes first (prompt, seed/variation, references, duration), then a mode change, then a model switch only as a last resort with the consistency cost stated. Adapt the revised prompt to the user's voice; no generation is run.

frame_notes.description: Optional: what you see in the bad frames.

frame_url.description: Optional link to a bad frame (Atlas does not open it; describe it in frame_notes).

issue.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

mode.description: Mode used: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, start/end frame, video-to-video, lip sync.

seconds.description: Clip length used (helps check spoken-line fit).
